anchor: v1::Sofia Lindgren. I opened the action camera from ORD-20652 but it doesn't fit my helmet mount. Can I return it?

result.text: Hi Sofia, your return for ORD-20652 is started (return number RMA-20652). I logged it as a fit issue, since the camera doesn't work with your helmet mount.
